speaker: Doctor
text: The lesions sound like they might be contagious given the daycare exposure, so could you describe their appearance in more detail, such as their color and if they have any fluid or scabs? Also, has your child had any recent fever or seemed unusually tired?

text: Past medical history: Previously healthy, up-to-date immunizations, no significant illnesses. Social history: Attends daycare three times per week.
